preconditions.expression: all(c in {'C', 'H', 'E', 'F'} for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of uppercase letters from the set {'C', 'H', 'E', 'F'}.
The length of the input string is between 1 and 100,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximal number of moves, where each move removes exactly one subsequence 'CHEF' (4 characters).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max(moves for moves in [sum(counts[char] // required[char] for char in 'CHEF') for counts in [collections.Counter(stdin.strip())]] if all(counts[char] >= required[char] for char in 'CHEF'))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of complete 'CHEF' subsequences that can be formed by greedily using the minimum count of each character ('C', 'H', 'E', 'F') divided by their required counts (1 each).
